references.text: Previous instructions regarding the daily burnt offering given in Exodus, where the Lord also speaks to Moses about the same sacrificial regulations that are expanded in Numbers 28.
A parallel introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses from the tent of meeting and gives instructions concerning offerings.
The same introductory formula is used at the beginning of Numbers, where the Lord speaks to Moses and gives him instructions.
A similar introduction where the Lord speaks to Moses and gives regulations about the offerings that Israel is to bring forward.
The Lord speaks to Moses about the appointed feasts, which is thematically connected with the regular offerings in Numbers 28.
